title: Practice 10: Setting out: пойти, поехать — and сходить, съездить

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Ну, ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot)) я.
exercises.why: **пошел** — past tense (masculine) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Зачем же я ___ (полезть — to start climbing)?
exercises.why: **полезу** — future tense (1st person singular) of полезть: the perfective of лезть, «set out».

exercises.q: Я не ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot))!.
exercises.why: **пойду** — future tense (1st person singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Но он ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot)).
exercises.why: **пошел** — past tense (masculine) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot)) в сад.
exercises.why: **пошли** — past tense (plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Вот я ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot)).
exercises.why: **пошла** — past tense (feminine) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Так и ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot))?
exercises.why: **пошла** — past tense (feminine) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: И ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot)) тут.
exercises.why: **пошло** — past tense (neuter) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Полезем да ___ (полезть — to start climbing).
exercises.why: **полезем** — future tense (1st person plural) of полезть: the perfective of лезть, «set out».

exercises.q: А как ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot))?
exercises.why: **пойдешь** — future tense (2nd person singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Не ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot)) ли?
exercises.why: **пойти** — infinitive, the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Как же ___ (слетать — to fly there and back)?
exercises.why: **слетает** — present tense (3rd person singular) of слетать: the perfective of the many-directions verb, meaning one trip there and back.

exercises.q: Все бы ___ (поплавать — to swim for a while).
exercises.why: **поплавать** — infinitive, the perfective of плавать meaning «for a while».

exercises.q: Да не ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot))!
exercises.why: **пойдут** — future tense (3rd person plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Да, он ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot)).
exercises.why: **пойдет** — future tense (3rd person singular) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: Думаешь, не ___ (полезть — to start climbing)?
exercises.why: **полезу** — future tense (1st person singular) of полезть: the perfective of лезть, «set out».

exercises.q: Но Рыжик не ___ (полезть — to start climbing).
exercises.why: **полез** — past tense (masculine) of полезть: the perfective of лезть, «set out».

exercises.q: Все ___ (понести — to carry off (on foot)) ее!
exercises.why: **понесли** — past tense (plural) of понести: the perfective of нести, «set out».

exercises.q: Как не ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot))?
exercises.why: **пойдёте** — future tense (2nd person plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».

exercises.q: А дети ___ (пойти — to go, set off (on foot))?
exercises.why: **пойдут** — future tense (3rd person plural) of пойти: the perfective of йти, «set out».
